reviewText: My girl's pee smell was getting to be too much for me in my small townhome. My cat's area is in the room across from my bedroom. She is 14 and there is no way she is getting banished to the outdoors, so I had to find an alternative.  I am cursed with an above average olfactory system. I can't even wear perfume or be around people who have on strong perfume. Air fresheners and scented wall plugins are not an option for me. I've woken up from the smell of her litter box and got out of bed to go dump it out in the middle of the night. That's how bad it gets. So, I decided to get rid of her stainless steel box and bought an automatic litter box to help me keep her box clean right after she does her business so it doesn't have a chance to permeate the air for too long. That has helped but after several days the urine smell was back. I would have to completely empty out the box every week and start fresh. That was getting to be too expensive. I've had many brands of clay litter and none of them were effective. "10 days odor free" is a lie. Maybe 1 day tops. Also, her area is on the second floor so hauling up cases of clay litter was not fun. I saw an ad on Instagram for this litter so I decided to give it a try when I saw that Walmart carried it. I've been using it about a month now and I really am quite pleased with how it neutralizes odors. My cat took to it right away. I just mixed it in with her clay to get her adjusted and she was unbothered. I'm not going to say that it's perfect and I can't smell a thing, but it is far superior to any clay I have ever used.
